answer: Convex funding-cluster reserve. Each identity must hold a refundable reserve c·n^p, where n is active identities in its funding cluster and p>1. Transactions are rejected below that reserve. The first identity is the vertex; the Nth must hold c·N^p. The curve rises along a ridge, so N sybils lock about c·N^{p+1}/(p+1), making each marginal identity cost c·N^p. Only audited stable units count; basalt does not satisfy the reserve.
